tagline: Gameplay programmer, songwriter, and doer of whatever else interests me (a lot)
lyrics: You'd fit perfectly to me, and we'd end our loneliness
Don't move so lightly, static snow, that is your memory
Though I'll never know your name, I'll cry for you the same
Nothing's gonna change my world
Nowhere man
Life is what happens to us while we are busy making other plans
With lovers and friends, I still can recall
In my life, I've loved them all
Her hair of floating sky is shimmering
There, running my hands through her hair
Each one believing that love never dies
Thoughts meander like a restless window inside a letter box
Turn off your mind, relax, and float downstream

Golden slumbers fill your eyes
Smiles await you when you rise
Nowhere man, please listen, you don't know what you're missing

Thought I'd been in love before
But in my heart, I wanted more
Pools of sorrow, waves of joy are drifting through my opened mind

Living is easy with eyes closed
misunderstanding all you see
I know I'll often stop and think about them
I want you to cry, but I'm biting my tongue
I could tell lies until they buy my story

But isn't it obvious to everybody?
'Cause it's obvious to me

Maybe someday I'll stop and laugh about it
Lying through my teeth
I spent a lifetime on this
I'll be alive next year
I can make something good

Dear future me,
I promise I'll take care of the person we'll both be eventually
I can't shake the feeling that I'll be happy by the time I'm him
Please be disappointed in me
You're everything to me
Give me a drug, bottle your love

You'd think I'd been chasing the dragon
You'd been watching me weep

"Some things are better left remembered
"How's that help me?

Carving in to the bridge
"It might not be so bad to die"
Hollowheart
Believing in a lie that we'll leave behind
Forever couldn't wait, we decide that there must be more
My ideals are inviolate. Invincible
I'll be your beast of burden

Has your journey been good?
Has it been worthwhile?

A sea of shimmering stars
Diamonds strewn across a raven gown, boundless and beautiful
If history must be unwritten, let it be unwritten
Maybe I'm amazed at the way you love me all the time
Maybe I'm a lonely man who's in the middle of something that he doesn't really understand

I was the dreamweaver
But now I am reborn
The dream is over
I don't believe in talent
I just believe in me
The world is just a little town

I don't expect you to understand
After you've caused so much pain
You're just a human, a victim of the insane
Everybody's trying to pull us down
Isolation

You're asking me, will my love grow?
I don't know
It's getting hard to be someone
100% in the bitch
pageDollMessages: No more sleeping, need to help, then sleep more
You look like someone who likes bowling
But, if I'm listening, I can't ask them questions like: what's your favorite color, and why does bread taste good, and do you think cats would smoke if they had thumbs?
Can I use your jacket as a blanket?!
Ima throw my pillow at 'em cause I'm carryin' a pillow and that's really all I can throw!
The best part of being asleep, is being asleep.
Viscous likes cubes. I like pillows...
Of course they can't stop me, I've brought my lucky pillow!
An interesting theory, Mr. Poirot, but I know who really killed Jay Gatsby...
They say if you snooze, you lose, but that's not true cause I snooze all the time and look at me now!
